designDoneChecklist: Paper not white: warm ivory ground, cards visibly float (1.13:1 lift + warm two-layer shadow); no two coplanar whites.
Depth is legible: every card casts a gathered warm two-layer shadow; the one focal card sits a step higher; dark cards show a top catch-light.
Serif present and restrained: Fraunces on wordmark/heroes/card+result titles (~3-6 strings/screen), Inter elsewhere, clear serif<->sans contrast, no Outfit.
Sections read editorial: every group has a saffron tracked-uppercase (Latin) eyebrow + hairline rule; no weak grey labels.
Saffron scarce and confident: <10% surface; #C2410C fills, #A8380A text, #FF9933 only on splash/logo; dark CTA reads brass not neon; no all-peach tiles.
The three moments land: Splash presses the Seal + draws the ink underline; Dashboard opens as a composed Almanac; results ink in block-by-block on a DocumentSheet (never a chat dump).

Motion confident not playful: staggered entrances, press-depress everywhere, skeletons (no bare spinner), Lift-&-Settle push, result reveal, all within 3-curve/<=420ms(<=600ms) budget; reduce-motion shows final frame instantly.
A11y holds under stress: every text pair AA; 48dp targets; longest Bengali+Tamil+Malayalam render no clipped matra at textScale 1.3/360dp/light+dark; Lucide-only, no emoji; dignified copy.
Looks curated not generated: composed asymmetry, masthead, seal, hairline discipline, tabular data.
